```{r}


# Illustrative parameter values
p <- c(
  mu1a_max = 0.8, delta1b_max = 0.6,
  mu2b_max = 0.7, delta2a_max = 0.5,
  K1a = 0.5, K1b = 0.5,
  K2a = 0.5, K2b = 0.5, Kl = 0.5,
  l2b = 0.3, l1a = 0.3,
  rho1a = 0.2, rho2b = 0.2,
  theta = 0.05, sigma = 0.01
)

# Initial consumer abundances and resource concentrations
initial <- c(C1 = 0.2, C2 = 0.2, Ra = 1, Rb = 1)

model <- function(time, state, p) {
  with(as.list(c(state, p)), {
    dC1 <- C1 * min(
      mu1a_max * Ra / (K1a + Ra),
      delta1b_max * Rb / (K1b + Rb)
    ) - C1 * (theta - sigma)

    dC2 <- C2 * min(
      mu2b_max * Rb / (K2b + Rb),
      delta2a_max * Ra / (K2a + Ra)
    ) - C2 * (theta - sigma)

    dRa <- C1 * rho1a * (l2b * C2) / (Kl + l2b * C2) -
      (C1 * mu1a_max * Ra / (K1a + Ra) +
       C2 * delta2a_max * Ra / (K2a + Ra))

    dRb <- C2 * rho2b * (l1a * C1) / (Kl + l1a * C1) -
      (C2 * mu2b_max * Rb / (K2b + Rb) +
       C1 * delta1b_max * Rb / (K1b + Rb))

    list(c(dC1, dC2, dRa, dRb))
  })
}

times <- seq(0, 100, by = 0.1)
out <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial, times = times,
                         func = model, parms = p))

# Plot consumers and resources separately
par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
matplot(out$time, out[, c("C1", "C2")],
        type = "l", lty = 1, col = 1:2,
        xlab = "Time", ylab = "Consumer abundance")
legend("topright", c("C1", "C2"), col = 1:2, lty = 1)

matplot(out$time, out[, c("Ra", "Rb")],
        type = "l", lty = 1, col = 3:4,
        xlab = "Time", ylab = "Resource concentration")
legend("topright", c("Ra", "Rb"), col = 3:4, lty = 1)
```


```{r}
# Base R only

simulate_population <- function(dormancy = TRUE,
                                years = 6,
                                dt = 0.01,
                                K = 1) {
  cycle <- 8                 # one wet/dry cycle
  dry_length <- 4
  times <- seq(0, years * cycle, by = dt)

  active <- numeric(length(times))
  dormant <- numeric(length(times))
  active[1] <- 0.5

  for (i in seq_len(length(times) - 1)) {
    t <- times[i]
    is_dry <- (t %% cycle) < dry_length

    if (is_dry) {
      growth <- 0.01
      active_mortality <- 1.5
      sporulation <- if (dormancy) 2.8 else 0
      germination <- if (dormancy) 0.01 else 0
    } else {
      growth <- 0.8
      active_mortality <- 0.03
      sporulation <- if (dormancy) 0.005 else 0
      germination <- if (dormancy) 1.4 else 0
    }

    # Growth is limited by the total population, including dormant individuals.
    total <- active[i] + dormant[i]
    per_capita_growth <- growth * max(0, 1 - total / K)

    d_active <- (per_capita_growth - active_mortality - sporulation) *
      active[i] + germination * dormant[i]

    dormant_mortality <- 0.003
    d_dormant <- sporulation * active[i] -
      (germination + dormant_mortality) * dormant[i]

    active[i + 1] <- max(0, active[i] + dt * d_active)
    dormant[i + 1] <- max(0, dormant[i] + dt * d_dormant)
  }

  data.frame(
    time = times,
    active = active,
    dormant = dormant,
    total = active + dormant
  )
}

without_dormancy <- simulate_population(dormancy = FALSE)
with_dormancy <- simulate_population(dormancy = TRUE)

# Shade desiccation periods in the plots.
shade_dry_periods <- function(years = 6, cycle = 8, dry_length = 4,
                              y_bottom, y_top, marker_width = 0.08) {
  for (start in seq(0, years * cycle - cycle, by = cycle)) {
    rect(start, y_bottom, start + marker_width, y_top,
         col = adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.25), border = NA)
    rect(start + dry_length - marker_width, y_bottom,
         start + dry_length, y_top,
         col = adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.25), border = NA)
  }
}

# Panel 1: total population size
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot(without_dormancy$time, without_dormancy$total,
     type = "n", log = "y", ylim = c(1e-10, 1.1),
     xlab = "Generation", ylab = "Population (log)",
     main = "Population Denisity Over Time")

shade_dry_periods(y_bottom = 1e-10, y_top = 1.2)

lines(without_dormancy$time, without_dormancy$total,
      col = "grey", lwd = 2)
lines(with_dormancy$time, with_dormancy$total,
      col = "black", lwd = 2)

legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("No dormancy", "Dormancy", "Stress"),
       col = c("grey", "black", "red"),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1), lwd = c(2, 2, 1), bty = "n")


```


```{r}
simulate_population <- function(dormancy = TRUE,
                                generations = 1000,
                                dt = 0.01,
                                K = 1) {
  cycle <- 8
  dry_length <- 4
  times <- seq(0, generations, by = dt)

  active <- numeric(length(times))
  dormant <- numeric(length(times))
  active[1] <- 0.5

  for (i in seq_len(length(times) - 1)) {
    t <- times[i]
    is_dry <- (t %% cycle) < dry_length

    if (is_dry) {
      growth <- 0.001
      active_mortality <- 0.02
      sporulation <- if (dormancy) 0.05 else 0
      germination <- if (dormancy) 0.001 else 0
    } else {
      growth <- 0.01
      active_mortality <- 0.001
      sporulation <- if (dormancy) 0.0002 else 0
      germination <- if (dormancy) 0.08 else 0
    }

    total <- active[i] + dormant[i]
    per_capita_growth <- growth * max(0, 1 - total / K)

    d_active <- (per_capita_growth - active_mortality - sporulation) *
      active[i] + germination * dormant[i]

    dormant_mortality <- 0.00005
    d_dormant <- sporulation * active[i] -
      (germination + dormant_mortality) * dormant[i]

    active[i + 1] <- max(0, active[i] + dt * d_active)
    dormant[i + 1] <- max(0, dormant[i] + dt * d_dormant)
  }

  data.frame(
    time = times,
    active = active,
    dormant = dormant,
    total = active + dormant
  )
}

without_dormancy <- simulate_population(dormancy = FALSE)
with_dormancy <- simulate_population(dormancy = TRUE)

# Mark the start and end of each dry period
shade_dry_periods <- function(generations = 1000, cycle = 8,
                              dry_length = 4, y_bottom, y_top,
                              marker_width = 0.08) {
  for (start in seq(0, generations - cycle, by = cycle)) {
    rect(start, y_bottom, start + marker_width, y_top,
         col = adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.25), border = NA)
    rect(start + dry_length - marker_width, y_bottom,
         start + dry_length, y_top,
         col = adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.25), border = NA)
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot(without_dormancy$time, without_dormancy$total,
     type = "n", xlim = c(0, 1000), ylim = c(0, 1.1),
     xlab = "Generation", ylab = "Population density",
     main = "Population Density Over Time")

shade_dry_periods(y_bottom = 0, y_top = 1.1)

lines(without_dormancy$time, without_dormancy$total,
      col = "grey", lwd = 2)
lines(with_dormancy$time, with_dormancy$total,
      col = "black", lwd = 2)

legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("No dormancy", "Dormancy", "Desiccation start/end"),
       col = c("grey", "black", "red"),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1), lwd = c(2, 2, 1), bty = "n")
```
